items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I used Walter Pichard, you know one of them.

ctx.x: No, he goes on to play, he's all right.

He's all fine. Something we've been talking about the last couple of days, see if we could raise a little money to do it, you know, rehearse and everything else. I got the alto player and I got the baritone player. Who's the alto player? I used Ricard, I used Ricard, that's right. I used Walter Pichard, you know one of them.
Walter Pichard would play? Sure, oh.
